title: lead.scored
description: Qualification finished scoring a lead: deterministic components plus the LLM's fuzzy sub-scores were combined into one total and band. Emitted by Lead Qualification. Consumed by the router (band decision already carried in the payload) and, later, Learning.

score_id.description: lead_scores.id of the append-only row this event describes.

industry_pack.description: The lead's PINNED pack name (leads.industry_pack) — the pack that actually produced this score, not whichever pack happens to be currently configured.

prompt_version.description: qualification/score_lead.md's version at the time of this call.

run_id.description: agent_runs.id of the qualification/score_lead complete_json() call.
